reviews.title: SECOND SIM FAILED TO ARRIVE. COMPLETE OPERATIONAL FAILURE.
reviews.body:
My experience with Lebara has turned into a total disaster:
- 21 Oct: Original SIM dispatched (Order ID: G0052868381) — Lost in transit.
- 28 Oct: CS Agent Arnold promised delivery by 2 Nov at the latest. Lebara's Director also replied on Trustpilot claiming someone would contact me "ASAP". Nobody ever reached out.
- 2 Nov: CS Agent Srushti abruptly closed my live chat within 60 seconds when I asked for an escalation.
- 2 Nov: Re-connected with CS Agent Sonali, who confirmed the loss and issued a replacement SIM (Order ID: CS0470232) promised within 3–4 working days.
- 7 Nov: the replacement SIM has STILL NOT ARRIVED.

That makes two consecutive SIM orders lost and over 17 days without service after paying upfront. Empty PR responses on Trustpilot and completely unreliable postal fulfillment. 

You can contact me at kontakfjb[at]gmail.com, do not ask for my contact details again.

Avoid Lebara at all costs.

--UPDATE
Lebara's "Director" replied asking for contact details, completely ignoring that my email was written right in the text above. This proves they don't even read reviews before dumping generic PR templates.

--UPDATE (7 Nov): The "Escalation Email" is an automated loop.
After the Director replied on Trustpilot asking me to email TrustPilotEscalations[at]lebara.com for "ASAP" support, I sent an email and instantly received an automated reply.

The bot tells me to wait 5–7 working days OR go back to Live Chat—the exact same chat where agents hang up abruptly. A complete circus of fake promises and infinite support loops.
